title: The Melted Chocolate
scene: At 11:50 AM, the chocolate showpiece melted. The tempering room was locked from 11:30 to 12:10.

suspects.name: Mira Vale
suspects.alibiProof: The molding camera shows Mira at 11:48.

suspects.name: Noah Pike
suspects.alibiProof: The wrap log shows Noah's station at 11:49.

suspects.name: Olive Reed
suspects.testimony: I was at the counter at 11:50.
suspects.alibiProof: The counter camera shows Olive at 11:51.

suspects.name: Quinn Ash
suspects.testimony: I was in the tempering room at 11:50, checking the thermometer.
suspects.contradiction: The tempering room was locked from outside, and melted chocolate marked Quinn's apron.
